notes.title: Summer Rivals 2025 is starting!
notes.content:
☀️ We’re live! Summer Rivals 2025 has officially started!


Beach? Forget it. This summer, there’s only one mission: become the sudoku champion! 💥



The event runs from today until August 31 — rankings, XP, big fights for the top. But before you start smashing numbers, an important note: XP counting will begin after we finish technical maintenance, which is happening right now.



🔥 Why should you get hyped?

The harder the sudoku, the bigger your XP bonus.

The earlier you play after we open XP counting, the higher your daily multiplier.

The leaderboard updates in real time — track your progress and chase your friends.



🎚️ Difficulty boost? Of course!

Very Hard sudoku? +32% XP.

Hard? +16%.

Tutorials? Forget it — this event is for true warriors.



⏳ Daily multiplier? You bet!

At the start, XP is raining down. Every day, the multiplier drops, so playing earlier means a serious advantage.



🧩 Play — climb. Don’t play — drop.

Simple? Yes. Fair? Absolutely.



🚧 Technical note

The event is officially live, but we’re currently wrapping up final tweaks and prep work. Multiplayer may be temporarily unavailable, and XP counting will kick in right after maintenance is done.



🏁 Ready? Summer Rivals 2025 is about to go full throttle.

Stay close — once XP counting starts, the real race begins. See you on the leaderboard! 😎🔥

notes.title: Summer Rivals 2025: The rivalry of this summer is coming!
notes.content:
☀️ Holidays? Beach? A sunshade? Not this time…
This season, real tough ones are sitting in front of their screens, sweating over sudoku, because it’s time for SUMMER RIVALS 2025 – our first official ranking event. And yes, there will be XP. A lot of XP. But not for slackers… So get to work!




🎯 What’s this all about?
From July 1 to August 31, in every game mode, we’re activating the XP bonus system that will define your position in the leaderboard. The more difficult the level and the earlier the day – the bigger the XP gain. Doesn’t matter if you play solo or in co-op. In short: I play = I get more XP than usual. I play harder = I get even more XP. I play earlier = I get more XP than my buddy.

🧠 Remember!
🏆 Leaderboard is based on XP – those who play smart and early will rise!

💪 The boost fades daily – you lose 1% every day!

🧩 Harder levels pay more – this event isn’t for slackers, it’s for thinkers.




😵‍💫 It’s almost time!
The holidays will end. The boost will end. But the leaderboard will remain. And only one question will matter: Will you be on it? We’ll find out. SudokuNexus Summer Rivals 2025 runs from July 1 to August 31, 2025 – starts at midnight, ends at midnight.

notes.title: Got a head for numbers? Try the SudokuNexus demo!
notes.content:
🔥 On May 30th at 6:00 PM CET, something’s dropping that will set your brain on fire – the SudokuNexus demo! 🚀🧩 This ain’t your grandma’s sudoku next to the horoscopes. This is a digital arena of logical warfare, where style, speed, and challenge reign supreme! 💼🧠💡

🎮 What’s in the demo?

Only singleplayer for now – but with three spicy modes that’ll hook you harder than doomscrolling TikTok at 3AM:
🔹 Standard – classic sudoku, perfect for a cozy evening with tea 🍵
🔹 Time Attack – race the clock! ⏱️ Fill the grid before time eats you alive!
🔹 Brainstorm – vanishing numbers and timer pressure? A mode for those who love suffering… logically 😈⚡

🤔 Who’s it for?

SudokuNexus is for anyone who:
✅ Feels pure joy from placing the perfect digit
✅ Needs to prove they’re the sudoku alpha
✅ Loves beautifully designed logic games with soul 🖤
✅ Says “just one more puzzle”… 3 hours later 😅

🎁 Add SudokuNexus to your wishlist so you won’t miss upcoming updates – the full version will feature multiplayer, achievements, and other juicy extras! 🎉

See you on May 30th – bring your brain, we’ll handle the rest. 😎🧠💻

notes.title: We are back after a long-term break!
notes.content:
🎉 We’re back with fresh updates!
After a longer break, we’re excited to bring you another batch of improvements and features that take SudokuNexus to the next level. Check out what we’ve prepared in the latest update – from technical enhancements to brand-new additions that will make your gameplay even more enjoyable!

🌍 English Language Version

With players from around the world in mind, we’re preparing a full English language version of SudokuNexus. The translation of the interface and in-game messages is in its final stages and will be released in one of the upcoming updates. This will make the game more accessible and open to a new global community.

🖥️ Fullscreen Mode

We’re introducing fullscreen mode to significantly improve the gameplay experience – especially for players who enjoy fully immersing themselves in the world of Sudoku. You’ll be able to enable it from the settings menu. We’re also working to ensure it runs smoothly across all devices, and it might become the default mode in the future.

NOTE: This mode currently only works with a resolution of 1960 x 1080!

⚙️ Extended Game Settings

Time for more personalization! The current settings are quite basic, so we’re planning to expand them step by step. In future versions, you’ll find new options that let you customize the look, pace, and style of the game to better suit your preferences. We want every player to enjoy Sudoku their own way.

notes.title: SudokuNexus Developer Notes #1: What’s new?
notes.content:
Recently, things have been a bit quiet on our end, but it’s just an illusion – we’ve been working hard behind the scenes on the development of SudokuNexus! Very soon, we’ll begin rolling out a series of updates that will significantly change your gameplay experience. Each update will focus on specific aspects of the game and will introduce long-awaited improvements and new features.

Below, we present what we’re currently working on – some of these features will be added to the game very soon, while others will appear in upcoming updates.

🌍 English Language Version

With players from all over the world in mind, we’re preparing a full English language version of SudokuNexus. The translation of the interface and messages is in its final stages and will be available in one of the upcoming updates. This will make the game more accessible and open to a new community.

🖥️ Fullscreen Mode

We’re introducing fullscreen mode, which will significantly enhance the gameplay experience – especially for players who like to fully immerse themselves in the world of Sudoku. It will be available in the settings menu. We’re also working to ensure it functions smoothly on all devices, and it may become the default mode in the future.

⚙️ Expanded Game Settings

Time for more personalization! The current settings are quite basic, so we plan to gradually expand them. Future versions will include new options that allow players to customize the look, pace, and style of the game to their liking. We want everyone to play the way they enjoy the most.

🤝 Multiplayer Reworked

We’ll be temporarily disabling the current standard multiplayer mode – it still contains too many bugs affecting the smoothness and correctness of gameplay. But don’t worry! We’ll rebuild the multiplayer system from scratch, fixing all the issues and expanding its capabilities. When it returns, it will be available in a fully improved version – also within the new game modes.

🧪 New Game Modes

We’re preparing two brand-new game modes that will bring a fresh twist and more variety to the gameplay. Their release is planned in the coming weeks, after the major updates are rolled out. We’ll reveal more details soon, but we can say this – it’s going to be exciting!

Thank you for being with us! Your suggestions, feedback, and engagement mean the world to us. It’s thanks to you that SudokuNexus continues to grow and evolve. An exciting time lies ahead, and we can’t wait for you to try out all the new features!

notes.title: 🧠🔥 SudokuNexus NEWS: YOU’RE A LEGEND… OR YOU HAVE A PROBLEM! 🎉
notes.content:
Is it talent, determination, or just an addiction to numbers? It doesn’t matter! If you’ve spent more time in SudokuNexus than you probably should, we have exclusive achievements for the real veterans!

🔔 Check which ones you’ve already unlocked! 👇

🏆 No Life?

💬 Played 1000 games. Maybe take a break… or just one more round?

✨ If you’re still unsure how to get this:
✅ Start playing Sudoku.
✅ Stop keeping track of time spent in SudokuNexus.
✅ Open your eyes – you’ve played 1000 games.

📢 We’re not saying anything, but…
If your answer to “What have you been up to lately?” is “Playing Sudoku”, then the title of this achievement probably makes sense.

🏆 Come on, Give It a Rest!

💬 Beat Sudoku 1000 times, and you’ll officially become a SudokuNexus genius.

✨ In short:
✅ Think fast.
✅ Fill in the numbers without hesitation.
✅ Do it 1000 times, because who needs a break?

📜 Just a small digression…
Einstein once said that genius is 1% talent and 99% hard work. We’d add a few percent of obsession to that.

🏆 The Millennium Meltdown

💬 If Sudoku has crushed your dignity 1000 times, we’ll reward you with this unique title. We hope you’ll still come back for more defeats.

✨ Quick guide for those interested:
✅ Make mistakes.
✅ Click “New Game” with full confidence.
✅ Repeat 1000 times.

📜 We’re not saying anything, but…
If you’ve lost this many times and still haven’t quit, you’re either a legend of persistence or just enjoy suffering.

🏆 Minister of Digital Affairs

💬 Got this achievement? Congratulations! You’ve officially made more mistakes than the average politician.

✨ Want this title? Here’s the recipe:
✅ Place numbers at random.
✅ Don’t check if they fit.
✅ Reach 1000 mistakes and smile like you’re on camera during an interview.

📜 Fun fact on the side…
Some mistakes go down in history. Yours, unfortunately, only show up in the SudokuNexus stats.


🎉 Which of these have you already unlocked? Or maybe you’re just a few games away from the elite club?

💬 Brag about your Sudoku Legend status!

🔥 SudokuNexus – for those who count faster than others think! 😆

notes.title: Statystyki i ranking już (prawie) są!
notes.content:
Zgodnie z obietnicą stało się! W dniu dzisiejszym opublikowana została aktualizacja do wersji 0.27 gry SudokuNexus w ramach której udostępniamy dla Was rankingi oraz statystyki. Oprócz tego wprowadziliśmy kilka istotnych zmian i poprawek o których opowiemy poniżej.

Statystyki i ranking

W ramach aktualizacji 0.27 pojawi się do Waszej dyspozycji zakładka Ranking w której sprawdzicie swoje pozycje w rankingach oraz dotychczasowe statystyki. Przeglądając tą zakładkę zauważycie, że wprowadziliśmy podział na tryby oraz na wyniki ogólne. Wiemy, że obecnie dostępne statystyki są dość proste i mało szczegółowe, ale z biegiem czasu na pewno będziemy je dalej rozwijać. 

Jeśli chodzi o system rankingów warto wspomnieć o zasadzie działania w kilku zdaniach:

 Na Twoją pozycję w każdym z 4 rankingów będą wpływać wygrane i przegrane gry.
 Jeśli wygrasz - otrzymasz punkty, które poprawią Twoją pozycję. W przeciwnym razie stracisz punkty, co obniży Twoją pozycję.
 Rankingi będą realizowane w ramach sezonów, dzięki czemu będziemy mogli wprowadzać zmiany, które znacznie będą wpływać na różne aspekty rozgrywki.
 

W tej chwili system rankingów jeszcze nie działa, ale jest już on gotowy. Statystyki już są dla Was dostępne i możecie do nich śmiało zaglądać.

Inne zmiany i poprawki

 Zmieniliśmy delikatnie wygląd paska nawigacyjnego w zakładce Opcje
 Poprawiliśmy błędne nazwy okien w grze
